title: Would have been 5 stars if I had received the whole set
text:
Would have been 5 stars if I had received the whole set. These containers are perfect for me. I used them to put leftovers in the freezer and then I put them in the microwave. The food come out as good as it was before freezing. I also put sandwiches for lunch in them. The sandwiches are fresh, and I don’t use plastic sandwich bags.

The box comes with 19 trays and 20 tops (mine was short one tray), The tray is not sectioned so you can put sandwiches in them. These trays are stackable, freezer safe, microwave safe, and you can use them over and over.

I have recommended these containers to family and friends.
